description: As Kansas lawmakers debate how to regulate the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence data centers, Representative Kirk Haskins is raising questions about their impact on communities and the need for clearer safeguards. In an October 15 report from The Capital-Journal, Haskins warned that development is moving quickly while lawmakers still lack reliable information about appropriate protections.
